nodes.summary: Discrete Umlaufsatz (theorem of turning tangents) for lattice walks without right turns: a simple closed walk on `ℤ²` whose every turn is straight or a left quarter turn has exactly four left turns, i.e. its direction makes one full counterclockwise revolution. Right turns and reversals are excluded by hypothesis, so the walks covered are exactly counterclockwise boundaries of lattice rectangles (no reflex corner);…
nodes.title: Discrete Umlaufsatz for lattice walks without right turns

nodes.summary: Hopf's Umlaufsatz for lattice polygons. A simple closed walk in `ℤ²` with at least three steps and no U-turns has total turning `±4` quarter turns, that is rotation index `±1` (H. Hopf, *Über die Drehung der Tangenten und Sehnen ebener Kurven*, 1935).
nodes.title: Hopf's Umlaufsatz
